description: This Python module provides utilities for configuring and generating JWT tokens for LiveKit rooms, specifically for use with the Pipecat system. It includes functions to generate tokens for participants and agents, and supports environment variable and command-line configuration.

methods.name: str generate_token(room_name: str, participant_name: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str)
